title: ReproAgent: Contract-Guided Paper-to-Code Reproduction
abstract: arXiv:2608.24291v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Paper-to-code reproduction asks scientific AI agents to turn research papers into executable repositories that preserve the paper's method, protocol and artifacts. This is difficult because the specification is split: explicit paper content such as algorithms, metrics and artifacts is often lost across long agent trajectories, while implicit details such as framework defaults and conventions inherited from related work are absent from the paper. We introduce ReproAgent, a four-stage Prepare--Plan--Generate--Repair pipeline built around a persistent implementation contract with two channels: an implementation-requirement channel that turns paper snippets into code obligations, and a reference-evidence channel that retrieves content and structure evidence from related repositories. translated_title: ReproAgent：合同引导的论文到代码复现
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24291v1 公告类型：新 摘要：论文到代码复现要求科学AI代理将研究论文转化为可执行的代码库，并保留论文的方法、协议和工件。这很困难，因为规范是分散的：显式论文内容，如算法、指标和工件，在长代理轨迹中经常丢失；而隐式细节，如框架默认值和从相关工作继承的约定，在论文中则不存在。我们引入了ReproAgent，这是一个四阶段的准备-计划-生成-修复流水线，围绕一个持久的实现合同构建，该合同有两个通道：一个实现需求通道，将论文片段转化为代码义务；一个参考证据通道，从相关代码库中检索内容和结构证据。两者都绑定到工作包，投影到文件级合同，并在生成和修复过程中被消费。在PaperBench Code-Dev上，ReproAgent达到了...
tldr: ReproAgent通过一个双通道的实现合同（需求与证据）驱动四阶段流水线，有效解决论文到代码复现中显式内容丢失和隐式细节缺失的问题，在PaperBench Code-Dev上取得显著性能。
en_tdlr: ReproAgent uses a dual-channel implementation contract (requirements and evidence) to drive a four-stage pipeline, effectively addressing the loss of explicit content and absence of implicit details in paper-to-code reproduction, achieving notable performance on PaperBench Code-Dev.
